task.title: Allocating vacation pay that is paid because of a layoff or separation

step.cmd: In NWS, determine if separation monies other than vacation pay were also paid upon separation:

ul.li: If no, go to step 2.
If yes, refer to Allocating separation monies . Allocating separation monies

step.cmd: Determine if the monies will be allocated on a claim that meets one of the following conditions:

ul.li: The BPC is between March 30, 2025 (w/c 2493), and October 10 , 2026 (w/c 2572 ).

The vacation pay would otherwise be allocated under EIR 36(9) to 36(11) and the first week of allocation falls within the period beginning March 30, 2025 (w/c 2493) to October 10 , 2026 (w/c 2572 ). EIR 36(9) 36(11)
The vacation pay is reviewed on or after September 25, 2022 (w/c 2362) and the allocation start date is between September 26, 2021 (w/c 2310) and September 24, 2022 (w/c 2361).
The vacation pay information is reviewed between September 26, 2021 (w/c 2310) and September 24, 2022 (w/c 2361).
For an initial claim, the BPC is between September 27, 2020 (w/c 2258) and September 19, 2021 (w/c 2309).
For a renewal claim, the allocation start date is between September 27, 2020 (w/c 2258) and September 19, 2021 (w/c 2309).

For a continuing claim, the allocation start date is between September 27, 2020 (w/c 2258) and September 19, 2021 (w/c 2309).
If no, go to step 3.
If yes, go to step 31.

step.cmd: Determine if the allocation starts from the last week worked:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 4.
If no, go to step 6.

step.cmd: Determine if the ELWW are less than the NWE:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 5.
If no, go to step 6.

step.cmd: Determine the amount to allocate as follows:

ul.li: Subtract the earnings of the last week worked from the NWE. The result is the amount to allocate in that week.
Subtract the result from the total vacation pay.
Divide the balance of the vacation pay by the NWE. This gives you the number of weeks for the allocation at the NWE.
Multiply the number of full weeks of allocation by the NWE.
Subtract that total from the total amount of vacation pay.
The balance is allocated on the last week.
Go to step 7.

step.cmd: Determine the amount to allocate when the ELWW are equal to or greater than the NWE or when the allocation starts later in the BP using the following formula:

ul.li: Divide the vacation pay by the NWE. The result is the number of weeks for the allocation.
Take the number of full weeks of allocation and multiply that number by the NWE.
Subtract that total from the total amount of the vacation pay.
The balance, if any, is allocated on the last week.

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if there is a registration number on file:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 7.

If no, select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and assign a registration number as follows:
Action: Select Assign .
Claim Source: Select 3 - Mail/Revised Decision .
Service Unit: Select 1 .
Decision Type: Select 3 - Revised .
Select Update .

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if the claim for benefits is active, terminated or blocked or archived:

ul.li: If the claim is active, go to step 9.

If the claim is terminated, but may be reactivated:
Under the Dormant tab, select the appropriate BPC.
Select Reactivate .
Go to step 9.
If the claim is blocked or archived, go to step 15.

step.cmd: Determine which of the following situations applies:

ul.li: If the ELWW are less than the NWE and the allocation starts from the last week worked, go to step 10.
If the ELWW are equal to or greater than the NWE or the allocation starts later in the BP, go to step 11.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Allocations (M175) transaction and input the allocation as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.

On the first line, do the following:
Type: Select V - Vacation pay only .
Amount: Enter the top-up amount determined in step 5 of the section Allocating vacation pay that is paid because of a layoff or separation . Allocating vacation pay that is paid because of a layoff or separation
Start date: Enter the last week worked.
End date: Enter the last week worked.
Last week amount: Leave this field blank.

On the second line, do the following:
Type: Select V - Vacation pay only .
Amount: Enter the NWE.
Start date: Enter the last week worked + 1.
End date: Enter the last week of the allocation.
Last week amount: Select the appropriate option:
If the allocation amount in the last week is less than the NWE, enter that amount.
If the last week of allocation is equal to the NWE, leave this field blank.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select A - Non-fraud - Earnings and employment .
Message: Select 32 - Your vacation/holiday pay was not deducted .
Contentious: Select 2 - Yes .

Complete: Select the appropriate option:
To complete the registration number, select C - Yes .
To leave the registration number open for subsequent transactions, select D - No .
Select Update .
Go to step 12.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Allocations (M175) transaction and input the allocation as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.

On the first line, do the following
Type: Select V - Vacation pay only .
Amount: Type the NWE.
Start date: Enter the first week of the allocation.
End date: Enter the last week of the allocation.
Last week amount: Select the appropriate option:
If the allocation amount in the last week is less than the NWE, enter that amount.
If the last week of the allocation is equal to the NWE, leave this field blank.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select A - Non-fraud - Earnings and employment .
Message: Select 32 - Your vacation/holiday pay was not deducted .
Contentious: Select 2 - Yes .

Complete: Select the appropriate option:
To complete the registration number, select C - Yes .
To leave the registration number open for subsequent transactions, select D - No .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Refer to Extension of the benefit period , then go to step 13.
Under the Summary tab, determine if there is a stop pay related to these earnings and do one of the following:

ul.li: If no, go to step 14.

If yes, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction and remove the stop payment as follows:
Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Manual Action: Select the appropriate MA.
Rescind: Check the box.
Contentious: Select 2 - Yes .
Complete: Select the appropriate option:
To complete the registration number, select C - Yes .
To leave the registration number open for subsequent transactions, select D - No .
Select Update .

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if the allocation must also be input on a blocked claim:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 15.
If no, go to step 30.

step.cmd: Determine the blocked claim’s CS by reviewing the Blocked Status column under the Blocked tab:

ul.li: If 1 - Updateable is displayed, go to step 16.
If 2 - Not blocked is displayed, return to step 8.
If any other CS is displayed, go to step 26.

step.cmd: Review the Blocked Action Pending column:

ul.li: If Yes is displayed in one of the rows, go to step 17.
If all rows are blank, go to step 19.

step.cmd: In NWS, move the WI to Pending as follows:

ul.li: Pending reason: Select Other .
Comments: Type “Waiting for an updateable CS in BCS.”
Bring forward date: Enter [the next business day].

step.cmd: When the WI moves to the current workload, in FTS, review the Blocked Action Pending column under the Blocked tab:

ul.li: If Yes is displayed in one of the rows, return to step 17.
If all rows are blank, go to step 19.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the BPC you want to update from the Blocked Status column. When the Blocked Claim screen opens, complete the following:

ul.li: Action required: Select Claim update .
Agreed deduction: Select (100%) Blocked claim system default .
Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised (or 2 - Renewal , if necessary).
Contentious: Select 2 - Yes .

Complete: Select the appropriate option:
To complete the registration number, select C - Yes .
To leave the registration number open for subsequent transactions, select D - No .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Determine which of the following situations applies:

ul.li: If the ELWW are less than the NWE and the allocation starts from the last week worked, go to step 21.
If the ELWW are equal to or greater than the NWE or the allocation starts later in the BP, go to step 22.

step.cmd: Under the Allocations tab, input the allocation in the Allocations section as follows:

ul.li: Action: Select A - Add .

On the first line, do the following:
Type: Select V - Vacation pay only .
Amount: Enter the top-up amount determined in step 5 of the section Allocating vacation pay that is paid because of a layoff or separation . Allocating vacation pay that is paid because of a layoff or separation
Start date: Enter the last week worked.
End date: Enter the last week worked.
Last week amount: Leave this field blank.

On the second line, do the following:
Type: Select V - Vacation pay only .
Amount: Enter the NWE.
Start date: Enter the last week worked + 1.
End date: Enter the last week of the allocation.
Last week amount: Select the appropriate option:
If the allocation amount in the last week is less than the NWE, enter that amount.
If the last week of allocation is equal to the NWE, leave this field blank.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select A - Non-fraud - Earnings and employment .
Message: Select 32 - Your vacation / holiday pay was not deducted .
Select Update .
Go to step 23.

step.cmd: Under the Allocations tab, input the allocation in the Allocations section as follows:

ul.li: Action: Select A - Add .
Type: Select V (Vacation pay only).
Amount: Enter the amount allocated per week.
Start date: Enter the start date of the allocation.
End date: Enter the end date of the allocation.

Last week amount: Select the appropriate option:
If the allocation amount in the last week is less than the NWE, enter that amount.
If the allocation amount in the last week is equal to the NWE, leave this field blank.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select A - Non-fraud - Earnings and employment .
Message: Select 32 - Your vacation / holiday pay was not deducted .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Under the Pending Transactions tab, review the transaction:

ul.li: If the transaction shown is incorrect, go to step 24.
If the transaction shown is correct, select Close and go to step 25.

step.cmd: Delete the incorrect transaction as follows:

ul.li: Delete: Check the box next to the incorrect transaction.
Select Update .
Return to step 20.

step.cmd: Refer to Extension of the benefit period , then go to step 30.
Refer to Extension of the benefit period , then go to step 27.
In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operation Centre Memo (MM06) transaction as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Memo (MPS): Check the box.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select A - Non-fraud - Earnings and employment .
Message: Select 32 - Your vacation/holiday pay was not deducted .
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select D - No .
Select Update .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: BPC: Select the BPC of the vacation pay.
Work item: Select 91 - Overpayment .
Work type: Select 2 - Non-misrepresentation .
Remarks line 1: Type “Input M175 V-$XXXX (amount to allocate) from XXXX (first day of allocation) to XXXX (last day of allocation), $XXX (amount to allocate on last week if different).”

Remarks line 2 (to be used if top-up amount is to be input): Type “Input M175 V-$XXXX (amount to allocate) from XXXX (first day of allocation) to XXXX (last day of allocation), $XXX (amount to allocate on last week if different).” Example of transaction: Remarks line 1: V-$400-2388-2388 Remarks line 3: V-$700-2389-2391
Remarks line 4: Enter the information about the BP extension, if necessary.
Remarks line 5: Enter your first name and last name.
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select C - Yes .
Select Update .

step.cmd: To transfer the registration number to IPOC, select the appropriate registration number from the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Action: Select Change registration flag .
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .
Select Update .

step.cmd: In ACS, create and send a D-20-16-03 letter. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li:
Allocations of Earnings (2516) Select the appropriate option:
Allocation of earnings - Only from ROE #1 - Monies allocated beyond BPC
Allocation of earnings - Monies allocated beyond BPC are from both ROE #1 + ROE #2

step.cmd: In NWS, complete the WI or return to the previous task.
